title: Development and evaluation of deep learning-based segmentation of histologic structures in the kidney cortex with multiple histologic stains

sections.title: 研究问题
sections.text:
《Development and evaluation of deep learning-based segmentation of histologic structures in the kidney cortex with multiple histologic stains》：研究问题的原文依据。

【Abstract · abstract-1-1】The application of deep learning for automated segmentation (delineation of boundaries) of histologic primitives (structures) from whole slide images can facilitate the establishment of novel protocols for kidney biopsy assessment.

evidence.text: The application of deep learning for automated segmentation (delineation of boundaries) of histologic primitives (structures) from whole slide images can facilitate the establishment of novel protocols for kidney biopsy assessment.

sections.title: 研究方法
sections.text:
《Development and evaluation of deep learning-based segmentation of histologic structures in the kidney cortex with multiple histologic stains》：方法与研究设计的原文依据。

【Abstract · abstract-1-3】For development, we examined 125 biopsies for Minimal Change Disease collected across 29 NEPTUNE enrolling centers along with 459 whole slide images stained with Hematoxylin & Eosin (125), Periodic Acid Schiff (125), Silver (102), and Trichrome (107) divided into training, validation and testing sets (ratio 6:1:3).

【Abstract · abstract-1-5】Twenty deep learning models were trained with optimal digital magnification across the structures and stains.

evidence.text: For development, we examined 125 biopsies for Minimal Change Disease collected across 29 NEPTUNE enrolling centers along with 459 whole slide images stained with Hematoxylin & Eosin (125), Periodic Acid Schiff (125), Silver (102), and Trichrome (107) divided into training, validation and testing sets (ratio 6:1:3).
Twenty deep learning models were trained with optimal digital magnification across the structures and stains.

sections.title: 主要结果
sections.text:
《Development and evaluation of deep learning-based segmentation of histologic structures in the kidney cortex with multiple histologic stains》：结果的原文依据；数值与适用人群以引文为准。

【Abstract · abstract-1-6】Periodic Acid Schiff-stained whole slide images yielded the best concordance between pathologists and deep learning segmentation across all structures (F-scores: 0.93 for glomerular tufts, 0.94 for glomerular tuft plus Bowman's capsule, 0.91 for proximal tubules, 0.93 for distal tubular segments, 0.81 for peritubular capillaries, and 0.85 for arteries and afferent arterioles).

【Abstract · abstract-1-8】Silver stained whole slide images yielded the worst deep learning performance.

evidence.text: Periodic Acid Schiff-stained whole slide images yielded the best concordance between pathologists and deep learning segmentation across all structures (F-scores: 0.93 for glomerular tufts, 0.94 for glomerular tuft plus Bowman's capsule, 0.91 for proximal tubules, 0.93 for distal tubular segments, 0.81 for peritubular capillaries, and 0.85 for arteries and afferent arterioles).
Silver stained whole slide images yielded the worst deep learning performance.
